onboardingComplete:
That's how it works 🙂

Send a word, a phrase or a whole sentence — back comes the same kind of breakdown: meanings, real examples and the nuances an ordinary dictionary leaves out.

The buttons under it:
🔄 Other meaning — when the sense is off
🎯 Clarify meaning — context and shades
💾 Save — the word goes to your dictionary

Saved words come back for review on their own, right when they start to fade. That's how they stay in your head.

⌨️ Next to the input field:
🎴 Cards — practice on your own words
🧑‍🏫 Mentor — a conversation with an AI teacher
📖 Dictionary — everything you saved
Everything else — /menu

Send a word you've been meaning to figure out 👇
onbIntro:
🌍 Polyglot Monster — the translator that explains.

Not just a word, but its meanings, examples, nuances, and how people actually say it.

Setup takes 30 seconds.
